svg.title: Figure 3-7. Harness box intercept switch, animated (WP-H-02)
svg.desc: Animated circuit, 4 frames: 1. SBU1 undriven: stock path (nominal): SBU1 0.00 V, VTH 4.20 V, stock path. 2. Device drives SBU1: intercept (nominal): SBU1 4.62 V, VTH 4.20 V, intercept. 3. Pull-down open, SBU1 undriven, IN leaks to VIN (DFM-010.C3): SBU1 13.86 V, VTH 4.20 V, intercept. 4. Drive at the low band, threshold and VIN at the high band (DFM-011.C2): SBU1 3.35 V, VTH 8.00 V, stock path.
svg.text: Figure 3-7 · Harness box intercept switch, animated
ngspice scenarios of the harness box v3 switch path, 4 frames of 4 s: the stock path, intercept, and two DFMEA faults that leave the box in the wrong state
SBU1 against the DG419LE input threshold; VIN is the box supply
CAN switch path · harness box v3
U1 on CAN_H, U2 on CAN_L (DG419LE, R on 30 Ω); 8 clamp diodes to VIN and GND not drawn

g.text: SBU1 is not driven, so the box rests in the stock path: the camera's CAN reaches the car directly and the device only listens on both buses.
ngspice: IN reads pass-through (SBU1 -4.20 V from the threshold)
The device drives SBU1 above the threshold: U1 and U2 change over. The camera now talks only to device bus 2, terminated in the box, and device bus 0 drives the car.
ngspice: IN reads intercept (SBU1 +0.42 V from the threshold)
Pull-down open, SBU1 undriven, IN leaks to VIN
With R2/R3 open and SBU1 undriven, IN floats up on its leakage: the box sits in intercept with the device off, so the stock camera stays cut off from the car.
ngspice: IN reads intercept (SBU1 +9.66 V from the threshold)
Drive at the low band, threshold and VIN at the high band
At high VIN with a high threshold and a weak drive, SBU1 stays below VTH: the device asks for intercept but the box stays in the stock path.
ngspice: IN reads pass-through (SBU1 -4.65 V from the threshold)

svg.text: 3. Pull-down open, SBU1 undriven, IN leaks to VIN
4. Drive at the low band, threshold and VIN at the high band
Synthetic data, no evidence credit (DQ-413). Idealised switches; the DG419LE threshold at VL = VIN and the device's SBU1 driver are bands, not published values.
Generated by fig_h02_box_anim.py from spice/box-v3-nominal.cir and sim/results/harness-box.json; nothing is hand-listed but the frame order and each frame's sentence.

g.text: Terms: CAN controller area network: the vehicle's data bus · COM common terminal of a changeover switch · DFM-nn DFMEA row: failure mode DFM-nnn, cause .Cn (08-analyses/fmea) · DFMEA design FMEA: failure modes and

effects analysis of a design (here the harness box and device) · DQ-nn decision of the project lead (decision register) · GND ground · HE-nn hazardous event (HARA) · MCU microcontroller: the panda safety processor

(STM32H7) · NC normally closed terminal of a changeover switch (connected to COM when not driven) · NO normally open terminal of a changeover switch (connected to COM when driven) · VIN vehicle identification

number; in the harness box and its simulations, the box supply voltage · VL logic supply pin of the DG419LE switch (in the harness box, tied to VIN) · VTH threshold voltage of an input (in the harness box, the

DG419LE input threshold) · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
